title: Kid vs Dad 03: Square eyes (rhyming) (rough draft)
idea: Kid vs Dad 03 "Too much TV gives you square eyes": Dad warns Tato all night without once looking up from his phone; the reporter checks Tato's eyes at 8 pm, 11 pm and 3 am; the neighbour shows why the rule exists; at the end Tato's eyes are still round and Dad's are phones.

captionOverBody.reason: close-ups where the speaker fills the phone frame; captions in the upper third over the body, never the eyes (rule from the 8-min film trial, Jonny OK 20 Nov)

hook.what: Warning. Look what TV can do.

captions.text: We're live. Tato, age seven. Nine hours of TV.
In this house, one rule, you see: one more hour... and *square you'll be.*
Last warning. I'm not joking around.
*Hour twelve.* Read me the top row.
Who made the letters so small? I can't read this at all.
You want to end up like him? Next door?
Sir. How long did you watch before?
One summer. *1998.* I just sat and stared.
*Hour sixteen.* The whole season. No break.
Five more minutes... then I'll go.
See, Dad? Still round. And you?
